title: 堆

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: Release verified against production JSON through L281.
usageNotes: Do not use 挖、洞、土、泥 in display text, spokenText, displayLines, focusChar, or Stage 4 option text.
Images may describe sand, toy bridges, wood, and blocks, but the image itself must not contain text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, or watermarks.
本課尚未學「挖、洞、土、泥」，不可使用這些字。
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for every image.
Use L058 lesson images only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family continuity from L154/L162/L163 for protagonist mother, father, and little girl.
Every human prompt must explicitly name the role identity.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, wall writing, or readable marks.
Toy bridge scenes must be clearly toy or safe viewing scenes, never realistic bridge danger.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.

Generate G02 prefix/suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩在家中或遊戲區把積木堆得很高。畫面要清楚看到積木堆高；積木不可有字母、文字、數字、標籤或注音。
一座橋下堆著很多木頭，主角小女孩在安全距離看著。畫面要清楚是木頭堆在橋下，不要做成危險場景；不可有文字、數字、路牌、標籤或注音。
一座蓋得很好的橋，主角小女孩和主角爸爸或工人在安全位置看著。畫面要清楚表現橋很穩、蓋得好；不可有文字、數字、標籤或注音。
主角小女孩在沙地或安全遊戲區用沙子蓋一座小山。畫面重點是沙子堆成的小山，不是房子；不可有文字、數字、標籤或注音。
主角小女孩堆的積木太高，積木堆歪斜差點倒下。畫面要清楚是積木快倒但安全；積木不可有字母、文字、數字、標籤或注音。

stage4Plan.reason: 「積木堆很高」是本課核心用法，目標字清楚。
